subject: update valkey in serverLog messeges in server.c file (#231)
reason: The change only rewrites the text of three serverLog/serverPanic messages in server.c (replacing 'Redis' with 'Valkey') in the OOM panic handler, the systemd supervision notices, and the ARM64 COW-bug warning.
